title: Evocation Magic
description: If you aren't a Wizard, you can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from the **Evocation** (substance: elemental energies; verbs: lesser sculpt; minor channel) School of Magic. At the start of each session, you get Aether equal to your int. For more details, see the Wizard Starting Move, **Weave the Arcane**.

outcomes.text: If you're a Wizard, add the following verbs to your repertoire:

submoves.description: You can mark 1-3 Conditions to recover the same amount of Aether.

title: Contingency
description: Spend 1-3 Aether then choose a spell or a Move that you have access to that you could reasonably prepare in advance. Also, define a specific circumstance. When the **circumstance occurs**, roll+Aether spent; use the result to resolve the spell or Move.

title: Elemental Cloak
description: Spend 1-3 Aether to evoke a cloak made of one of the following elements. Replace X with the amount of Aether spent:

bullets: Cascading flames — Up to X opponents who inflict dmg to you suffer Xd6 dmg
Rock protrusions — Add +X to your armor for X attacks
Water tentacles — Up to X opponents who inflict dmg to you have **dis** to their dmg rolls
Wild gale — You can move unimpeded up to **near** X times

title: Instant Fireball!
description: Spend 1-3 Aether, then a **near** target and everyone **close** to them suffers Xd6 dmg **piercing**, where X is the amount of spent Aether.

title: Power Weapon
description: When you shape an elemental energy in the form of a weapon, spend 1-3 Aether and roll+Aether spent.

outcomes.text: Choose two of the following tags.
The element breaks free; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

submoves.description: By default the weapon inflicts 1d6 dmg, is **hand**, and has 3 uses. When you **Trade Blows** with this weapon, roll+int (instead of +str or +dex) and mark one use.
